verdict.rationale: Lovable's built-in Cloud backend is explicitly said to include 'AI' alongside database, auth, storage, and functions 'with no infrastructure setup required,' implying AI/LLM features can be added without the user managing provider keys. However, the evidence pack gives no detail on how AI/LLM calls or agent building actually work, what providers are used, or how key management is abstracted beyond this one-line mention. missing for 10: dedicated docs on adding LLM calls/agents, explanation of provider key handling, examples of AI feature usage, independent corroboration.
